skill.name: plans-management
skill.description: Helps update Plans.md task lists with consistent sections, status markers, completion dates, archives, and handoff notes for Claude Code and PM workflows.
skill.summary: Maintain Plans.md tasks, status markers, completion records, and archive sections.
skill.author: Chachamaru127

security_audit.summary: All static command-execution findings are false positives caused by markdown backticks, marker examples, and non-executed documentation snippets. The entropy findings are also false positives because the cited files are readable Japanese markdown with emoji and tables, not obfuscated content. No prompt injection, credential access, network behavior, or hidden execution intent was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.suggestion: Keep command examples clearly fenced as documentation and avoid phrasing that tells the agent to run shell commands automatically.

remediation.issue: The skill relies on modifying Plans.md content directly.
remediation.suggestion: Require the agent to preserve existing user content and show planned task changes before writing large updates.

content.value_statement: Teams lose time when task status, ownership, and handoff notes drift across files. This skill keeps Plans.md organized with consistent sections, markers, dates, and archive rules.
actual_capabilities: Adds new tasks to the correct Plans.md section with supported status markers.
Changes task markers between requested, TODO, work in progress, complete, verified, and blocked states.
Updates completion dates and keeps completed tasks in a consistent format.
Moves older completed tasks into archive sections while preserving task history.
Documents related files, subtasks, blockers, priorities, task IDs, and dependencies when provided.
limitations: It only defines workflows for Plans.md and related task marker documentation.
It does not implement project work or review code changes by itself.
It depends on the agent preserving existing Plans.md content accurately.
It does not enforce dependencies with a separate scheduler or database.

use_cases.title: Coordinate PM Handoffs
use_cases.description: A project manager can add requested work and mark reviewed tasks without changing the expected Plans.md format.

use_cases.title: Track Claude Code Work
use_cases.description: A developer using Claude Code can move tasks from TODO to WIP and then to complete with related file notes.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project History
use_cases.description: A team lead can archive verified completed tasks by date while keeping recent work easy to scan.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new Plans.md item.
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a new Plans.md task for updating the onboarding copy. Put it in the unstarted section with a short detail note.

prompt_templates.title: Start Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Move an existing task into active work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update Plans.md so the task "Create billing settings page" is marked as work in progress. Preserve its existing details.

prompt_templates.title: Complete and Document
prompt_templates.scenario: Mark a task complete with implementation context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Mark "Fix profile validation" complete in Plans.md. Add today as the completion date and note the related form and API files.

prompt_templates.title: Reorganize Status and Archive
prompt_templates.prompt: Review Plans.md, keep current tasks in the correct sections, mark blocked tasks with reasons, and move verified tasks older than seven days into the archive.

output_examples.input: Add a task for login validation and include related files.
output_examples.output: The skill would place the task in the unstarted section, apply the requested marker, and add related file notes under the task.

output_examples.input: Mark the user API task complete.
output_examples.output: The skill would move or update the task in the completed section, set the complete marker, and add a completion date.

output_examples.input: Archive finished work from last month.
output_examples.output: The skill would group verified completed tasks under the archive month while keeping active and pending tasks in place.

best_practices: Give the exact task title when changing status so the agent updates the intended item.
Include blocker reasons, related files, and dates when they matter for handoff clarity.
Review large Plans.md rewrites before accepting them, especially when several tasks have similar names.
anti_patterns: Do not use this skill for general implementation work outside Plans.md updates.
Do not mix multiple marker formats unless backward compatibility is required.
Do not remove empty standard sections, because they preserve the expected structure.

faq.question: What file does this skill manage?
faq.answer: It is designed for Plans.md task lists and the marker conventions documented in the skill.

faq.question: Can it add new task details?
faq.answer: Yes. It can add descriptions, related files, blockers, priorities, IDs, and dependencies when you provide them.

faq.question: Does it run project commands?
faq.answer: No. The skill documentation allows reading and editing files, not executing shell commands.

faq.question: Can it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatible workflows.

faq.question: How should blocked tasks be written?
faq.answer: Use the blocked marker and include a clear blocker reason, owner, or expected resolution date when known.

faq.question: When should tasks be archived?
faq.answer: The documented workflow archives verified completed tasks after they are old enough to move out of the active view.
